exposure: maternal age at delivery: < 17 years; 18-28 years; 29-39 years; > 40 years
cohort: 22,933 single pregnancies delivered in a tertiary referral center between 2001 and 2014
finding: Maternal age over 40 was an independent risk factor for preterm delivery, PRHDs, GDM, cesarean section, abnormal fetal presentation, and fetal PVL, while maternal age under 17 or over 40 was an independent risk factor for grade 3 or 4 neonatal IVH.
mod_finding: Maternal age over 40 years was an independent risk factor for cesarean section.
